headlines.title: 多重稳市信号释放，资本市场着力强韧性、提信心
headlines.summary: 稳市信号持续释放，投融资两端同向发力。从中央政治局会议到监管部门密集座谈，从一揽子金融政策发布到央国企、上市公司增持行动……一套稳市场、强韧性、稳预期的“组合拳”持续发力。在业内人士看来，密集释放的稳市信号，勾勒出清晰的改革主线：以制度确定性对冲外部不确定性，让“韧性”成为市场承压底色，让“信心”沉淀为长期共识。在投资端，长钱持续流入、回报机制完善，让市场拥有抵御波动的“压舱石”；在融资端，优质供给增加、制度包容性提升，让市场具备价值发现的“底盘”。韧性与信心互为表里——当市场能以制度韧性消化外部冲击、以优质资产回报长期信任，“有信心”将成为市场运行的常

headlines.title_en: Multiple Market-Stabilizing Signals Released, Capital Markets Focus on Strengthening Resilience and Boosting Confidence
headlines.summary_en: Market-stabilizing signals continue to emerge, with coordinated efforts on the investment and financing sides. From the Politburo meeting to intensive regulator symposiums, from a package of financial policies to share purchases by central and state-owned enterprises and listed companies... a coordinated set of measures to stabilize the market, strengthen resilience, and steady expectations is steadily taking effect. Industry insiders believe the dense flow of stabilizing signals outlines a clear reform roadmap: offset external uncertainty with institutional certainty, make "resilience" the market's underlying support under pressure, and let "confidence" settle into long-term consensus. On the investment side, continued inflows of long-term capital and improved return mechanisms give the market a "ballast stone" against volatility; on the financing side, increased high-quality supply and greater institutional inclusiveness give the market a "chassis" for value discovery. Resilience and confidence are mutually reinforcing—when the market can absorb external shocks through institutional resilience and reward long-term trust with quality asset returns, "confidence" will become the norm in market operations.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 刘海星率中共代表团访问古巴并出席首届“菲德尔国际对话”
headlines.summary: 8月8日至10日，中共中央对外联络部部长刘海星率中共代表团访问古巴并出席首届“菲德尔国际对话”。其间，同古共中央第一书记、古巴国家主席迪亚斯-卡内尔，古共中央政治局委员、中央组织书记莫拉莱斯，古共中央国际关系部部长洛萨达等会见交流。双方表示，将共同落实好两党两国最高领导人达成的重要共识，赓续传统友谊，深化党际交往，加强战略沟通与协作，携手推进各自国家社会主义事业，为中古命运共同体建设作出更大贡献。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Liu Haixing Leads CPC Delegation to Cuba and Attends First 'Fidel International Dialogue'
headlines.summary_en: From August 8 to 10, Liu Haixing, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, led a CPC delegation to Cuba and attended the first "Fidel International Dialogue." During the visit, he met with Cuba's First Secretary of the Communist Party and President Miguel Díaz-Canel, Politburo member and Secretary of Organization Morales, and Director of the International Relations Department Lozada, among others. Both sides expressed commitment to implementing the important consensus reached by party and state leaders, carrying forward traditional friendship, deepening inter-party exchanges, strengthening strategic communication and coordination, jointly advancing their respective socialist causes, and making greater contributions to the China-Cuba community with a shared future. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 综合多重因素，赴港投保性价比被重新评估
headlines.summary: 近日调研获悉，受“香港保单收益征税”消息影响，一些消费者正重新评估赴港投保性价比。已有多位香港保险营销员接到客户咨询，他们明显感受到市场正在降温。此外，随着人民币汇率不断升值，赴港投保的预期收益有所降低。在业内人士看来，受税收、汇率等因素影响，短期内消费者赴港投保将会降温，尤其是投资型保险产品受影响更大。对于消费者而言，未来赴港投保应综合考虑产品、汇率、合规、服务等多方面因素。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Comprehensive Factors Prompt Reassessment of Value of Hong Kong Insurance Policies
headlines.summary_en: Recent research indicates that amid news of "taxation on Hong Kong policy returns," some consumers are reassessing the value of buying policies in Hong Kong. Several Hong Kong insurance agents have already received client inquiries, and they clearly feel the market is cooling. Additionally, as the RMB exchange rate continues to appreciate, expected returns from Hong Kong policies have declined. Industry insiders believe that due to tax, exchange rate, and other factors, consumer demand for Hong Kong policies will cool in the short term, especially for investment-type insurance products. For consumers, future Hong Kong policy purchases should comprehensively consider product, exchange rate, compliance, service, and other factors. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: Hong Kong’s commercial property investment growth beats peer Asia-Pacific markets
headlines.summary:
Hong Kong’s commercial property investment more than doubled to US$3.1 billion in the second quarter, making it the fastest growing investment market in Asia-Pacific thanks to a strong increase in retail and office deals and a low base effect, according to JLL.
The 129 per cent growth from a year earlier beat other top-performing markets including Singapore with 108 per cent growth and Australia with an 82 per cent increase, data tracked by the property consultancy showed.

headlines.title_zh: 香港商业地产投资增长跑赢亚太同业市场
headlines.summary_zh: 仲量联行数据显示，香港第二季度商业地产投资额倍增至31亿美元，成为亚太地区增长最快的投资市场，得益于零售和写字楼交易强劲增长及低基数效应。同比129%的增幅超过了新加坡等其他表现领先的市场。

headlines.title: What makes McDonald’s assets stand out amid a weak Hong Kong retail property market?
headlines.summary:
One year after McDonald’s began selling its self-owned Hong Kong shops, the fast-food giant has found buyers for nearly half its portfolio even as the city’s retail property market endures its weakest spell in decades.
McDonald’s planned to dispose of all 23 shops in phases, market sources said, with the portfolio initially valued at about HK$3 billion (US$382 million).

headlines.title_zh: 在港零售物业市场疲软之际，麦当劳资产因何脱颖而出？
headlines.summary_zh: 麦当劳开始出售其自持香港店铺一年后，这家快餐巨头已为近半数物业找到买家，尽管该市零售物业市场正经历数十年来最疲弱的时期。市场消息人士称，麦当劳计划分阶段处置全部23家店铺，该组合初步估值约30亿港元（约合3美元）。

headlines.title: 金融产品网络营销新规9月底起实施，保险业提前摸排整治账号端乱象
headlines.summary: 金融产品网络营销最严监管规定——《金融产品网络营销管理办法》将于9月30日起实施。记者从相关渠道获悉，针对办法对保险机构网络营销划定的“硬杠杠”，监管部门正在主动摸排整治账号端乱象、厘清市场生态，为新规落地铺路。受访人士表示，随着监管部门整治深入和办法落地实施，“机构担责+人证合一+可回溯”将是保险网络营销的最终走向。从长期看，这有利于降低消费者的信任成本，激活真实保险需求，推动保险机构业务质量、续保率等长期指标提升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: New Rules on Online Marketing of Financial Products to Take Effect End of September, Insurance Industry Moves to Clean Up Account-Side Irregularities
headlines.summary_en: The strictest regulatory rules for financial product online marketing—the "Measures for the Administration of Online Marketing of Financial Products"—will take effect on September 30. Sources indicate that regulators are proactively investigating and rectifying account-side irregularities and clarifying the market ecosystem to pave the way for the new rules. Interviewees said that as regulatory crackdowns deepen and the measures take effect, "institutional accountability + identity verification + traceability" will be the ultimate direction for insurance online marketing. In the long run, this will lower consumer trust costs, activate genuine insurance demand, and drive improvements in long-term metrics such as business quality and policy renewal rates for insurance institutions. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 高塔姆·阿达尼赢得美国证券欺诈指控的驳回
headlines.summary: 美国纽约东区联邦地区法院法官Nicholas Garaufis驳回了对高塔姆·阿达尼及其侄子萨加尔·阿达尼的共谋、证券欺诈和电信欺诈指控。 美国方面指控阿达尼参与了一项向印度政府官员行贿超过2.5亿美元以锁定太阳能合同的计划——阿达尼始终否认这些指控。 该裁决标志着阿达尼在美国法律麻烦的终结，此前他还曾与美国证券交易委员会（SEC）和财政部达成和解。

headlines.title_en: Gautam Adani Wins Dismissal of U.S. Securities Fraud Charges
headlines.summary_en: Judge Nicholas Garaufis of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York dismissed conspiracy, securities fraud, and wire fraud charges against Gautam Adani and his nephew Sagar Adani. U.S. authorities had accused Adani of involvement in a scheme to bribe Indian government officials more than $250 million to secure solar contracts—Adani consistently denied these allegations. The ruling marks the end of Adani's U.S. legal troubles, following prior settlements with the SEC and the Treasury Department.

headlines.title: 银行理财机构短期限产品规模增长过快触发监管提示
headlines.summary: 近日从业内获悉，长三角地区一家银行理财机构因上半年部分产品规模增长较快，收到监管部门提示函。该机构上半年整体规模增幅约为9%，位居行业前列。当前，银行理财存续规模已达33.6万亿元。在市场扩容过程中，部分机构借助短期限产品快速吸收资金，但投研能力、资产储备和流动性管理未必能够同步跟上。监管部门此次提示，意在推动银行理财机构合理把握扩张节奏，防范资金期限缩短与资产久期拉长可能形成的错配风险。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Rapid Growth of Short-Duration Bank Wealth Management Products Triggers Regulatory Alert
headlines.summary_en: Recent industry sources indicate that a wealth management institution in the Yangtze River Delta received a regulatory advisory letter due to rapid growth in some product scales in the first half. The institution's overall scale grew about 9% in H1, ranking among the industry's top. Current bank wealth management outstanding scale has reached 33.6 trillion yuan. During market expansion, some institutions rapidly absorbed funds via short-duration products, but investment research capabilities, asset reserves, and liquidity management may not have kept pace. The regulatory advisory aims to urge bank wealth management institutions to reasonably control expansion pace and prevent mismatch risks from shortening funding tenors versus lengthening asset durations. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 中报窗口期机构密集调研 创新药步入业绩与国际化兑现期
headlines.summary: 当前医药行业进入半年报密集披露期，机构调研热情明显升温。数据显示，截至8月10日，17家上市药企披露半年报，逾百家药企发布半年度业绩预告。7月1日至8月10日，百济神州、泽璟制药等74家药企接待机构调研，7家企业吸引超50家机构走访，百济神州接待调研机构数量超200家。业内人士认为，创新药板块正从估值驱动，转向业绩与全球化兑现共同驱动，已达成商务拓展（BD）合作的产品逐步进入海外关键临床、注册上市和商业化分成兑现阶段，而今年ESMO年会（2026年欧洲肿瘤内科学会年会）重要数据、重磅BD合作与技术突破，将持续成为板块重要利好催化。(中国证券报）

headlines.title_en: Institutional Research Intensifies During Interim Report Window, Innovative Drugs Enter Period of Performance and Internationalization Delivery
headlines.summary_en: As the pharma sector enters peak semi-annual report disclosure, institutional research activity is notably heating up. Data shows that as of Aug 10, 17 listed pharma companies disclosed semi-annual reports, and over 100 companies issued semi-annual earnings forecasts. From July 1 to Aug 10, 74 pharma companies including BeiGene and Zelgen received institutional research visits, with 7 companies attracting over 50 institutions, and BeiGene hosting more than 200 institutions. Industry insiders believe the innovative drug sector is shifting from valuation-driven to performance and globalization-driven, with products that have reached business development (BD) deals gradually entering overseas pivotal clinical trials, regulatory approvals, and commercialization revenue-sharing phases. This year's ESMO annual meeting key data, major BD deals, and technological breakthroughs will continue to serve as significant positive catalysts for the sector. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 多路资金买入黄金，机构热议新“击球区”出现
headlines.summary: 黄金近期迎来了一波强势反攻。8月以来，COMEX黄金期货价格突破4400美元/盎司关口，黄金ETF被净申购近20亿份，部分FOF、基金投顾等资金也回流黄金。随着压制金价的政策、资金、地缘“三座大山”边际改善，多家机构判断黄金已迎来配置“击球区”，建议关注阶段性修复机会。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Multiple Funds Buy into Gold, Institutions Discuss New 'Sweet Spot' Emergence
headlines.summary_en: Gold has recently staged a strong rebound. Since August, COMEX gold futures have broken through the $4,400/oz level, with gold ETFs seeing net subscriptions of nearly 2 billion units, and some FOFs and fund advisory capital also returning to gold. As the "three mountains" of policy, capital, and geopolitical pressures weighing on gold prices show marginal improvement, multiple institutions believe gold has entered its "sweet spot" for allocation and recommend focusing on phased recovery opportunities. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 美股收盘：三大指数集体收跌
headlines.summary: 美股收盘，三大指数集体收跌，标普500指数跌0.06%，道指跌0.11%，纳指跌0.32%。大型科技股方面，SpaceX涨4.23%，亚马逊涨1.32%，微软涨1.21%，苹果跌1.53%，美光科技跌1.89%，超威半导体跌2.85%，英伟达跌2.86%，高通跌3.39%，英特尔跌4.06%。中概股方面，阿里巴巴涨3.04%，携程涨2.12%，蔚来涨1.58%，京东涨1.52%，拼多多涨1.35%，哔哩哔哩涨1.33%，小鹏集团跌1.11%。

headlines.title_en: US stocks close: All three major indices end lower
headlines.summary_en: U.S. stocks closed with all three major indices lower: S&P 500 fell 0.06%, Dow fell 0.11%, Nasdaq fell 0.32%. Among large tech names, SpaceX rose 4.23%, Amazon rose 1.32%, Microsoft rose 1.21%, Apple fell 1.53%, Micron Technology fell 1.89%, AMD fell 2.85%, Nvidia fell 2.86%, Qualcomm fell 3.39%, Intel fell 4.06%. Among Chinese ADRs, Alibaba rose 3.04%, Trip.com rose 2.12%, NIO rose 1.58%, JD.com rose 1.52%, PDD rose 1.35%, Bilibili rose 1.33%, XPeng Group fell 1.11%.
